description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HomeController that provides basic health and status endpoints for the application, including root ('/'), health ('/health'), and readiness ('/ready') checks.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing endpoints for application health and readiness checks.

methods.name: home
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root path '/' and returns an 'OK' string with HTTP 200, useful for preview health checks.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns a JSON with status 'UP' indicating the service is operational.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/ready' and returns a JSON with status 'READY' indicating the service is prepared to serve traffic.
